templates.name: Freelance Work Contract
templates.description: Standard agreement between an independent contractor and a client specifying scope of work, deliverables, payment milestones, and IP ownership.
templates.sample_parties: Jane Doe, Freelance Developer (Contractor); TechNova Solutions Inc., represented by John Smith, CEO (Client)
templates.sample_terms: The Contractor shall deliver the completed software solution within 60 calendar days; The Client agrees to pay a fixed fee of $4,500 payable in two equal milestones: 50% upfront and 50% upon final acceptance; All intellectual property and source code created shall transfer unconditionally to the Client upon final payment; Either party may terminate this agreement upon 14 days written notice; Both parties agree to maintain strict confidentiality regarding proprietary materials.
recitals: WHEREAS, the Client desires to retain the services of the Contractor to perform specialized freelance work and technical deliverables; and
WHEREAS, the Contractor represents possessing the professional expertise, qualifications, and facilities necessary to perform such services in a timely and diligent manner.

templates.name: Service Agreement
templates.description: Comprehensive agreement defining services to be rendered by a service provider to a client, including SLAs, performance standards, and fees.
templates.sample_parties: Apex Cloud Systems LLC, Service Provider; Horizon Enterprises Inc., Customer
templates.sample_terms: The Service Provider shall maintain a system uptime guarantee of 99.9% during business hours; Monthly service subscription fee of $1,200 shall be invoiced on the 1st of each calendar month and payable within 15 days; In the event of service degradation, service credits shall be credited toward the subsequent billing cycle; Routine maintenance windows shall be scheduled on weekends with at least 48 hours advance notice; This agreement shall renew automatically on an annual basis unless cancelled with 30 days notice.
recitals: WHEREAS, Customer desires to engage Service Provider to deliver ongoing managed services, technical maintenance, and infrastructure support; and
WHEREAS, Service Provider agrees to furnish such services in accordance with the terms, conditions, and service levels set forth herein.

templates.name: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
templates.description: Legally binding mutual or unilateral confidentiality agreement protecting trade secrets, financial records, customer data, and technical IP.
templates.sample_parties: Aegis Biotech Laboratories (Disclosing Party); Quantum Capital Partners (Receiving Party)
templates.sample_terms: The Receiving Party agrees to treat all technical documentation, research data, and business plans as strictly confidential; Confidential Information shall only be disclosed to employees or advisers with a strict need-to-know; The obligations of non-disclosure shall survive for a duration of 3 years from the date of disclosure; In the event of legal compulsion to disclose, the Receiving Party shall provide prompt written notice to allow protective orders; Upon termination, all confidential documents, copies, and derivatives shall be destroyed or returned within 10 days.
recitals: WHEREAS, the Parties are entering into preliminary discussions regarding a potential strategic transaction or commercial collaboration; and
WHEREAS, in connection with said evaluation, Disclosing Party may reveal certain confidential, proprietary, and sensitive trade secrets to Receiving Party.

templates.name: Business Agreement
templates.description: Formal commercial agreement between two corporate entities establishing mutual obligations, deliverables, revenue sharing, and operations.
templates.sample_parties: Sterling Logistics Corporation (Party A); Pacific Retail Distributors Ltd. (Party B)
templates.sample_terms: Party A shall supply logistics, freight, and warehousing services across the designated regional centers; Party B commits to minimum monthly volume thresholds of 5,000 units; Net 30 day payment terms apply to all verified invoices; Both parties shall designate an account representative to conduct bi-weekly operational reviews; Neither party shall solicit or recruit the other party's personnel for a period of 12 months following termination.
recitals: WHEREAS, Party A and Party B desire to formalize an ongoing commercial business relationship on the terms and conditions outlined below; and
WHEREAS, both entities are duly incorporated, validly existing, and possessed of full corporate power to execute this Agreement.

templates.name: Lease Agreement
templates.description: Property lease and tenancy agreement outlining premises, monthly rent, security deposit, maintenance duties, and rules of occupancy.
templates.sample_parties: Oakridge Properties Group LLC (Landlord / Lessor); Marcus Vance & Sarah Vance (Tenant / Lessee)
templates.sample_terms: The leased premises is located at Suite 402, 100 Main Boulevard; The monthly rent shall be $2,200 due on the first day of each calendar month; A refundable security deposit of $3,000 shall be deposited prior to occupancy; Tenant shall not sublet or assign the premises without express written consent of Landlord; Landlord shall be responsible for structural repairs and exterior building maintenance; Quiet hours shall be observed between 10:00 PM and 7:00 AM.
recitals: WHEREAS, Landlord is the legal owner of the real property and improvements described as the Leased Premises; and
WHEREAS, Tenant desires to lease the Premises for residential or commercial tenancy, and Landlord agrees to lease same subject to the terms herein.
sections: 3. Monthly Rent, Due Date & Late Fees

templates.name: Employment Offer Letter
templates.description: Formal employment offer and terms of employment covering job title, compensation, benefits, probationary period, and workplace policies.
templates.sample_parties: Crestline Technologies Corp., represented by Elena Vance, HR Director (Employer); Alex Morgan (Candidate / Employee)
templates.sample_terms: Position Title: Senior Systems Engineer reporting to the Chief Technology Officer; Starting base salary of $115,000 per annum paid bi-weekly; Comprehensive health insurance, dental coverage, and 401(k) matching up to 4%; A probationary period of 90 calendar days will apply from the start date; Standard paid time off (PTO) accrual of 18 days per calendar year; Employment is at-will and subject to satisfactory reference and background verification.
recitals: WHEREAS, Employer is pleased to extend this formal offer of employment to Employee based upon qualifications and interview assessments; and
WHEREAS, Employee agrees to accept employment and devote full business time, attention, and energies to the performance of duties.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: General partnership contract detailing capital contributions, profit and loss distribution, voting rights, and dissolution rules.
templates.sample_parties: David Chen (Partner 1) and Priya Sharma (Partner 2), establishing Beacon Creative Studio
templates.sample_terms: Initial capital contributions: Partner 1 contributes $25,000 (50% equity) and Partner 2 contributes $25,000 (50% equity); Net profits and losses shall be divided equally in proportion to partnership equity; Major financial commitments exceeding $5,000 require unanimous written consent of all partners; Management duties shall be shared with Partner 1 handling operations and Partner 2 overseeing marketing; In the event of partner departure, remaining partner holds right of first refusal to purchase equity.
recitals: WHEREAS, the Partners desire to associate themselves as general partners in business under the terms and stipulations set forth herein; and
WHEREAS, the Partners have agreed to pool resources, capital, and professional talents for mutual commercial benefit.

templates.name: General Contract
templates.description: Versatile all-purpose legal contract suitable for transactions, agreements, mutual obligations, commitments, or specific understandings.
templates.sample_parties: Global Logistics Hub, Party of the First Part; Alpha Trading Network, Party of the Second Part
templates.sample_terms: Both parties agree to execute their agreed undertakings with professional diligence; Financial settlements shall be reconciled every 30 calendar days; Written notification must precede any proposed contractual amendments; All notices shall be delivered via registered mail or verified electronic mail; Any dispute shall initially undergo good-faith conciliation for 30 days prior to formal legal proceedings.
recitals: WHEREAS, the Parties have agreed to enter into this General Contract for good and valuable mutual consideration; and
WHEREAS, the Parties wish to record the comprehensive terms and understandings between them in this binding instrument.
